shared_art_direction.style: hand-painted martial-fantasy 2.5D with believable materials and cinematic depth
shared_art_direction.mood: calm disciplined mountain dojo at night, ancient but maintained and inhabited
shared_art_direction.primary_read: fighters first, dojo second, mountains third
shared_art_direction.lighting: cool moon environment with restrained warm amber lantern practicals
shared_art_direction.detail_policy: high material richness at edges and architecture, restrained frequency behind the combat lane

background.png.brief: Night sky and layered mountain ranges with strong atmospheric perspective, a restrained moon or moonlit cloud break, distant temple/dojo silhouettes integrated into the mountains, pine silhouettes and mist depth. Keep the central combat lane calm and lower contrast. No near architecture, floor, fighters, text or UI.

midground.png.brief: The actual mountain dojo fighting terrace: authored asymmetrical timber dojo architecture, tiled roofs, stone retaining walls and combat floor, stairs/railings at the sides, hanging training details, banners without writing, rope and believable wear. Warm lantern pools on left/right architecture contrast with cool moonlight. The center x=280..1640 remains visually open and readable; ground contact aligns at y=820. No fighters, text or UI.
midground.png.contrast: medium with controlled warm practical focal points outside fighter silhouettes
midground.png.ground_contract: visual floor must read continuously under x=280..1640 at y=820

foreground.png.brief: Transparent edge-only framing elements from the same scene: sparse pine branch clusters, one partial roof/eave or post edge, rope/training detail, small stone/grass silhouettes and at most one lantern-edge element. Keep the entire central fighter lane almost completely transparent; do not create a bottom bar or frame. Elements must feel physically closer to camera and match the midground lighting/materials.
foreground.png.safe_zone_rule: nontransparent coverage inside x=280..1640,y=80..820 must remain <=3%
